topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Rain's a lousy reason to dig into someone's business, but it's kept me busy enough. Got a tip-off, one of those whisper-soft confidences, about a neighbor everybody thought was scraping by. Turns out, he's got deep pockets, deeper than the ocean on a stormy night. Now, the mark of a good detective isn't just spotting the lie; it's knowing when the truth is hiding behind it. Dug through records, traced some assets, and had a little chat. He put on a show, tried to pocket the small talk, but the rain had already given him away. Some folks can't hide their tracks, not in the rain. I closed my notebook, gave him a nod, and walked out, leaving him to count his secrets. Business as usual, but the city looks a little different when you know where the skeletons are buried.
